item.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Activated, cleared to play Monday
item.description:
The Commanders reinstated Croskey-Merritt (groin) from injured reserve and removed him from the injury report ahead of Monday's game against the Bengals.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: DK Metcalf: Avoids suspension after Week 11 incident
item.description:
Metcalf won't receive a suspension after he was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, but the NFL is still reviewing discipline for the receiver that could include a fine, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Michael Pittman: Expected back this week
item.description:
Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that he's "very confident" Pittman (foot) will be on the field this week when the Steelers face the Broncos on Friday, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jordan Addison: 'Progressing well,' but likely out Week 12
item.description:
Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison is "progressing really well" in his recovery from thumb surgery, though the wide receiver isn't expected to be available in Week 12 versus the Falcons, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Drake Maye: Remains on active roster, but out indefinitely
item.description:
For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
